title: GOP Rep. Jason Smith apologizes for telling Democrats to 'go back to Puerto Rico'
summary: "There is a saying that I was taught by my parents, 'De todo lo malo, siempre sale algo bueno,' which in English means, 'From everything bad, something good will come of it,'" Cárdenas said in his statement.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Source: https://www.politico.com/story/2019/01/17/house-stopgap-bill-1109215

"There is a saying that I was taught by my parents, 'De todo lo malo, siempre sale algo bueno,' which in English means, 'From everything bad, something good will come of it,'" Cárdenas said in his statement.
